papers.what_it_is: A condensed-matter theory paper on topological phases of non-interacting fermions on rooted quantum trees, with a topolectrical-circuit experiment of a Su-Schrieffer-Heeger tree.
papers.why_not: The paper studies topological band theory and electronic-circuit emulation on tree graphs. It has no quantum computing workload, no machine learning, no finance and no evaluation method, so it bears on none of the five contexts.
